name: Adolfo Mandirola
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, weathered narrow face, slim build, quiet private expression
bio: A Swiss privateer, also listed as Adolphe Mandirola, who campaigned small-capacity Maseratis either side of the Second World War. Born in 1896 — the exact date is not recorded — he was one of the many independents who filled the voiturette grids of the late 1930s.
